## Lab Solutions

- [Lab Solutions](https://medtech4solutions.com/services/lab-solutions/): Comprehensive laboratory solutions including monitoring, compliance, staffing, GPO purchasing, and practice development for IVF facilities.
- [Real-Time Monitoring](https://medtech4solutions.com/services/lab-solutions/real-time-monitoring/): 24/7 OvaTools real-time monitoring with QC dashboards, equipment tracking, and automated alerts for IVF laboratory environments.
- [Regulatory Compliance](https://medtech4solutions.com/services/lab-solutions/regulatory-compliance/): FDA, CLIA, CAP, and AABB regulatory readiness — audit preparation, compliance programs, and ongoing quality management for ART laboratories.
- [Staffing Solutions](https://medtech4solutions.com/services/lab-solutions/staffing-solutions/): TS (ABB) certified embryologists and HCLD off-site directors — temporary staffing placement for fertility clinics and IVF labs.
- [GPO Purchasing](https://medtech4solutions.com/services/lab-solutions/gpo-purchasing/): Free to join — pool buying power with 300+ IVF practices and access 1,800+ vendor contracts for lab supplies, equipment, and services.
- [Practice Development](https://medtech4solutions.com/services/lab-solutions/practice-development/): IVF lab design, construction oversight, workflow optimization, and team training for new and growing fertility practices.

## Management Services

- [Management Services](https://medtech4solutions.com/services/management-services/): Five management service lines — marketing, call center, accounting, HR, and insurance — supporting the business operations of fertility practices.
- [Marketing](https://medtech4solutions.com/services/management-services/marketing/): Patient-acquisition campaigns, digital strategy, and brand development built specifically for fertility clinic growth.
- [Call Center](https://medtech4solutions.com/services/management-services/call-center/): Dedicated call center operations staffed by fertility-trained agents handling patient inquiries, scheduling, and follow-up.
- [Accounting & Finance](https://medtech4solutions.com/services/management-services/accounting-finance/): Financial oversight, budgeting, revenue reporting, and forecasting tailored to fertility practice financial management.
- [Human Resources](https://medtech4solutions.com/services/management-services/human-resources/): Recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and HR compliance for fertility clinic workforce needs.
- [Insurance & Risk Management](https://medtech4solutions.com/services/management-services/insurance-risk-management/): Professional liability insurance and risk management programs designed specifically for ART practices and IVF laboratories.
